text: The initiative includes the Disaster Management Fund (DMF) established by the 2013 Natural Disaster Management Law, budgetary contingency mechanisms, and participation in the ASEAN disaster risk financing ecosystem via SEADRIF. It coordinates with humanitarian financing mechanisms and involves technical engagement with international partners on sovereign disaster risk financing diagnostics and strategy development.

metadata.solution_name:
Cyclone-related Government Risk Financing in Myanmar, 
Disaster Management Fund (DMF), 
Southeast Asia Disaster Risk Insurance Facility (SEADRIF)
